adapterCommand: sh -c 'command -v lldb-dap >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec lldb-dap; command -v lldb-dap-18 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec lldb-dap-18; set -- /usr/bin/lldb-dap-*; exec "$1"'
installCommand: sudo -n apt-get update && sudo -n apt-get -y -o APT::Get::AllowUnauthenticated=false install lldb jq cmake ninja-build
name: C_CPP debugger
uninstallCommand: echo 'Debug tools are retained with the environment; disable the Kit to stop using them.'; exit 1
